commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Samuel Gigot (Marseille) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 0 Jonathan Gradit (Lens) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Angelo Fulgini. His header was precise and ended up in the top right corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:0.
90' The referee awards a corner and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) goes over to take it.
89' The resulting set piece from Marseille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Wesley Said (Lens) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
88' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) will take the corner.
86' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michael Murillo (Marseille) replacing Ismaila Sarr.
86' It is time for a substitution. David Costa (Lens) is on for Neil El Aynaoui.
82' Kevin Danso (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
80' Wesley Said (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Benoit Bastien interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
80' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:1.
76' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) sees a yellow card from Benoit Bastien after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
75' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the left post.

59' A bullet header by Elye Wahi (Lens) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post.
56' Substitution. Joaquin Correa makes way for Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille).
56' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
54' Renan Lodi (Marseille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
51' Vitinha (Marseille) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
50' Amine Harit (Marseille) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
49' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
48' The game is interrupted. Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Vitinha (Marseille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benoit Bastien ignores the protests.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' A yellow card for a tackle by Jonathan Gradit (Lens). Benoit Bastien doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
43' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
41' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
38' Florian Sotoca (Lens) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
37' Renan Lodi (Marseille) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
35' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
34' It looks like Massadio Haidara (Lens) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Bastien won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
31' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and signals a foul after Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) brought his opponent down.
30' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is penalised for holding. Benoit Bastien signals a set piece.
28' Elye Wahi (Lens) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
25' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
23' Facundo Medina (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation. Marseille earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
22' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
19' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' Kevin Danso (Lens) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate at all and goes well over the bar.
17' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
16' Vitinha (Marseille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
15' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Pau Lopez intercepts the ball.
13' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jordan Veretout (Marseille). Benoit Bastien saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Lens.
10' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
8' Vitinha (Marseille) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.
8' The linesman raises his flag. Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is adjudged offside.
7' Benoit Bastien blows for a foul after Elye Wahi (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
5' Massadio Haidara (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.
4' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Amine Harit (Marseille) touches the ball with his hand inside the box!
